item.title: Federal judge restricts DHS field operations looking for noncitizen voters
item.description: The judge found the department's field operations to identify noncitizens who voted likely violated the Voting Rights Act, which bars voter intimidation.

item.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
item.description: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.
item.content:encoded: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

item.title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
item.description: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

item.title: Achy from sitting at a desk all day? Try doing this

item.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

item.title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
item.description: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

item.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
item.description: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
item.description: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.
